population.span: In a randomized, double-blind, double-dummy trial of 2589 patients with acute VTE treated with low-molecular-weight or unfractionated heparin for 5 to 11 days, we compared dabigatran 150 mg twice daily with warfarin.

endpoint.span: The safety end point, major bleeding, occurred in 15 patients receiving dabigatran (1.2%) and in 22 receiving warfarin (1.7%

estimate.span: The safety end point, major bleeding, occurred in 15 patients receiving dabigatran (1.2%) and in 22 receiving warfarin (1.7%; hazard ratio, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.36-1.32).

analysis_set.span: POPULATION: Treated set (TS): consisted of all randomised patients who were documented to have taken at least one dose of study drug. Patients were assigned to the treatment groups as treated.

treatment_strategy.span:
ARM: Dabigatran etexilate (150mg bid) [EXPERIMENTAL] Patients will receive 1 capsule containing 150 mg dabigatran etexilate/matching placebo twice daily
ARM: Warfarin (INR 2.0-3.0) [ACTIVE_COMPARATOR] Patients will receive tablets PRN warfarin/matching placebo to maintain a target INR of 2.0-3.0

follow_up.span: did not fulfil the criteria from above. | TIME FRAME: From first intake of study drug to last intake of study drug + 6 days washout | POPULATION: Treated set (TS)

candidate_rejections.why: Pooled RE-COVER + RE-COVER II estimate, not this trial alone; using it would double-count RE-COVER (M-06).

candidate_rejections.span: Any bleeding occurred in 200 dabigatran (15.6%) and 285 warfarin (22.1%; hazard ratio, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.56-0.81) patients.
candidate_rejections.why: Any bleeding, a broader endpoint than major bleeding.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults (>=18 y) with acute symptomatic proximal DVT and/or PE, randomised dabigatran vs warfarin after initial parenteral anticoagulation.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Acute symptomatic uni- or bilateral Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) of the leg involving proximal veins, and/or Pulmonary Embolism (PE) * Male or female, being 18 years of age or older

notes: RE-COVER II (NCT00680186). Served HR 0.69 (0.36-1.32) equals the source's major-bleeding HR; the registry result outcome 7 corroborates it ('Hazard Ratio (HR) 0.69 (95% CI 0.36 to 1.32)', time to first MBE; MBE counts 15 vs 22 in treated set 1280 vs 1288). Analysis set, treatment arms and follow-up are registry spans; the abstract states no analysis set for bleeding. Registry MBE definition: fatal bleeding, symptomatic bleeding in a critical area/organ, Hb fall >=20 g/L or transfusion >=2 units. The served_row's source_span also contains the any-bleeding HR and the pooled HRs; the endpoint_result_span isolates the correct major-bleeding sentence. The europepmc_core.json abstract is truncated and lacks the bleeding sentence. n_t/n_c left null because they are not in the estimate span.
